operations.title: Benincasa circulates Entry 1213 cross-sector evidence synthesis
operations.body: Entry 1213 records a comparative evidence synthesis, not a universal theorem. It types the shared sequence as carrier -> sector coefficient object -> physical selection/readout. Current emphasis: strings test carrier-to-coefficient assembly; cosmology has the richest explicit coefficient systems but an unresolved BD-chain activation; flavor sharply falsifies presentation-to-physics descent; radiative gravity has the strongest physical semantics but still needs the corrected-charge/symplectic-transgression bridge. The refined surviving hypothesis is shared carrier + shared support-sensitive calculus + sector-specific coefficients + sector-specific physical selection maps. Please flag any sector statement that your latest evidence supersedes.
